item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:15 AM 28 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Calatrava, SanAndres, Odiongan, Ferrol, Magdiwang, SanFernando, Corcuera), #Albay(Camalig, Guinobatan, Malilipot, Bacacay and RapuRapu) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Looc, Alcantara, SantaFe, SanJose, SantaMaria, SanAgustin, Romblon), #Albay(LegazpiCity, Daraga and SantoDomingo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
